LESSON: VIRTUES IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Virtues in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Virtues in Islam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important for Muslims to practise virtues?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
2. describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
3. practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
4. value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

2. Practise: describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
3. Practise: practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
4. Practise: value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Virtues in Islam.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important for Muslims to practise virtues?
2. How can a Muslim student exercise contentment in his life?

SECTION: REMEMBER
